name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.XWE.security
title: XWE from ABE: per-ciphertext hops of k bits give 2^k * gain <= |W2|^2 * cost
statement: For ABE laws S, enumerations W1 (key halves) and W2 (attributes) and a post-processing map, if every hop hybLaw j -> hybLaw (j+1) (one ABE ciphertext switched from false to true) is a decision problem with k bits, then every machine distinguishing the XWE encryptions of false and true has 2^k * gain <= |W2|^2 * cost. This is the security of Theorem 3.2 of ePrint 2017/874 in concrete form; the hops are where ABE selective security (e.g. ring BGG+ under Ring-LWE) enters.
